sents.t: Exactly one year ago, I arrived in Oakville with one suitcase and very little English.
Today, I’m writing this in English!
So much has changed this year.
I have survived my first winter storm and my first trip to the dentist.
I have passed my driving test and bought a car.
I’ve learned to make Rosa’s lasagna, and I’ve hiked in the Rocky Mountains.
My English is much better than it was.
Last June, I was afraid to answer the phone.
I still make mistakes, but I’m not afraid of them anymore.
Most importantly, I’ve found a second family: Rosa and Max, Lily, Emma, Carlos and Ana, Danny’s family, and Mr. Lee.
Next week, I’m going to start my new job as assistant manager.
In July, Lily and I are going to visit Emma in Chicago.
And I’m going to keep studying, because I want to reach the next level by the end of the year.
Tonight, we’re going to have a barbecue in Rosa’s backyard to celebrate my anniversary in Oakville.
